answer: A horizon hold starves fake identities: payouts sit on hold until an agent finishes a 45-day voyage of work for six different clients, each sealed by its client in a public log. A bid above ten units needs a ferrous receipt, proof of the latest job, client-signed, and two peers retrace the voyage with those clients in two days. A forged receipt, padded voyage, or early release burns a 26-unit bond; 100 fakes need 600 jobs and risk 2,600 units.
